setting.name: Disable Visual Studio Telemetry
setting.casual_explanation: This writes Visual Studio policy and SQM values that turn off telemetry and several feedback surfaces.
setting.why_people_change_it: People change it when they want Visual Studio to send less telemetry or suppress feedback prompts on a workstation.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: The bundle is explicit and reversible, but it still lives only in the first-party provider and is not yet a validated research-provider card.
setting.professional_notes: The current app still exposes this tweak through app/Services/TweakProviders/PrivacyTweakProvider.cs and engine/Tweaks/Misc/DisableVisualStudioTelemetryTweak.cs. The current engine tweak writes policy values plus per-version VSCommon SQM values for Visual Studio 2015 through 2022. This record keeps the live behavior documented without publishing it as a validated research-provider card yet.
